title: Uniformly heated slab: parabolic profile (analytic)
description:
The heated_slab template with its analytic answer: steady conduction with a uniform heat source and both x faces at T_wall.
Analytic: T = T_wall + q x (L - x) / (2 k).
Derived values tab: rise_max vs q L^2 / (8 k) (~1e-6: with an even cell count the scheme's uniform offset q dx^2 / (8 k) cancels at the two centre cells), rise_mean vs q L^2 / (12 k) (offset not cancelled: 2 (dx/L)^2 = 2e-4) and flux_mean (mean |heat flux|) vs q L / 4 (exact).
Line profile tab: T_profile.

parameters.name: q_vol
parameters.description: uniform volumetric heat source in W/m^3

parameters.name: T_wall
parameters.description: temperature of both x faces in K

parameters.name: H_slab
parameters.description: slab height along y (insulated y faces: 1D)

parameters.name: dx_mesh
parameters.description: uniform cell size (an even number of cells along x)
